svg.aria-label: Two replicas find their differences with Merkle trees. Each replica builds a tree over the same key ranges. Step 1: they exchange root hashes; they differ, so something is out of sync. Step 2: they compare the two children; the left halves match, so that whole half, half the data, is skipped. Step 3: on the right side they compare the next level and find that only the block for keys in the 2000s differs. Step 4: only that block is sent and repaired. Instead of comparing every key, the replicas exchanged a handful of hashes.
